name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin 9% off its high; Binance says outflows have normalised after the record theft
state: Bitcoin was near $78,500 on 4 Nov, about 9% below its 52-week high, which alone would be Normal. Watch rests on Binance, a top-10 exchange: net withdrawals reached $4.7bn after the $6.3bn theft attributed to North Korea (Bloomberg, 2 Nov). On 3 Nov Binance said outflows had normalised, deposits exceeded withdrawals and 98% of stolen assets were replenished, though some withdrawals were still reopening (Dawn/Reuters).
for_you: Binance customers have faced withdrawal pauses on some assets. Exchange stress can spread to other platforms and crypto prices; stress is easing but not yet fully resolved.
rubric_hit: Top-10 exchange (Binance) under stress after $6.3bn theft = Watch; BTC drawdown 9% < 25%
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Dawn (Reuters) — Binance says outflows normalised as North Korea rejects US allegation
Bloomberg — Binance outflows reach $4.7 billion after North Korea hack

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
